subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT among the three distinct human races identified by Georges Cuvier (1828)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laplanderiod**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

**Human Races **

__
 
• The **18th and 19th centuries saw** widespread use of the **idea of race**, despite the fact that it was rooted in misunderstanding and dispute. 
 
• According to **Hooton (1926)**, a **"race" **is a significant** division of humanity**, whose members, with individual differences, are **distinguished as a group by certain combinations of morphological, metrical traits, primarily non-adaptive, that have been inherited from their shared ancestry**.
 
• Certain physical traits, like **skin colour, eye shape, and hair type, as well as genetic traits, like blood types, biochemical parameters, DNA**, etc., are thought to be the basis for the idea that humans can be divided into different races.
 
• Based on differences in** skin tone**, **Georges Cuvier (1828)** distinguished three distinct human races:
 
 
• **Caucasoid**
 
• **Negroid **and** **
 
• **Mongoloid**
 
 
 
• According to him, the **first race of humans was Caucasian**, and the other two races came into existence later on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Francois Bernier (1684)**, a naturalist, used face and physical features to divide people into four stocks, **creating the first systematic classification of humans**.
 
• **Buffon (1749)**, a monogenist, coined the **term "race" **in natural history and divided people into **six racial groups based on their skin tone, stature, and physical characteristics**: **Laplander, Tartar, European, South Asian, American, and Ethiopian**.
 
• Later, based on **geography and appearance**, the father of modern anthropology, **Blumenbach (1775)**, divided people into five races: **Mongolian, Malayan, Ethiopian, American, and Caucasian**.
 
• The **ABO blood group system's **distribution was used by **Reuben Ottonberg **to make the first attempt at **racial classification of people**.
 
• One could argue that the term "race" was coined by **anthropologists to describe the diversity of people**.
